certification.name: Certified Evidence Repair Technician - Forensic
certification.description: Mobile device repair for forensic extraction, covering disassembly, micro-soldering and replacement of ports, screens and buttons. The course page states the credential is earned by passing a practical competency exam at the end of the 5-day in-person course.
certification.currency_note: Price on request (no public price); exam taken at the end of the 5-day in-person course; optional training kit costs extra
